Tom — thanks for the clear list. We typically send via DocuSign (preferred) unless a customer mandates AdobeSign; both produce full audit trails. Proposed plan below: 

1) Envelope provider: DocuSign (primary) / AdobeSign (fallback)
2) Routing order: Sequential — GreenGrid (sign) -> Redwood primary signer -> Redwood countersign (legal)
3) Redwood primary signer: Claire Huang, VP Legal & Ops (empowered to sign DPAs)
4) Redwood backup signer: Martin Shaw, Head of Finance (if Claire unavailable)
5) KBA: Not required for corporate DPA; if GreenGrid mandates we can enable recipient authentication (phone or SMS).
6) Audit trail: DocuSign audit included; we will attach the certificate PDF to the envelope and send to you.

Next steps: Please confirm Claire Huang & Martin Shaw are acceptable or provide an alternate name/role. Once confirmed, I'll create the envelope and share the DocuSign link and route matrix (docsign-route-matrix.xlsx).
